csv_project_name: Consultant for Minneapolis Sandstone Tunnel Inspection
csv_scope_of_work: The Metropolitan Council will receive and publicly open separate sealed bids for Minneapolis Sandstone Tunnel Inspection. The work of this project: Clean and support personnel entry inspection of 58 maintenance holes ranging from 10 to 95 deep; clean and remotely inspect 16 maintenance holes ranging from 20 to 100 feet deep; support personnel entry inspection of approximately 21,300 linear feet of sandstone tunnel interceptor and drill and repair inspection holes in the interceptor crown; remotely inspect approximately 47,000 linear feet of sandstone tunnel interceptor; and install 17 boreholes ranging from 45 to 70 deep.
